verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented bulk or historical event import. The HTTP V2 endpoint [amplitude-docs-2] covers server-side event sending, but nothing describes batch uploads, historical timestamps, or migration from another tool. The export API [amplitude-docs-12] runs in the opposite direction, and cohort upload [amplitude-docs-29] covers cohorts, not events. The warehouse entries in the integrations directory (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) describe only the partner products and never state that events can be imported into Amplitude.
